desktop-clipboard-transfer.detail: Unit-tested (WEAK): 5,000-character text payload verified intact across software clipboard API (pyperclip); no physical keystrokes or mouse motion.

safety-graph-stall.detail: Unit-tested (WEAK): Graphify AST extraction verified in isolated temp directory; builds AST, updates on new files, and trips alert on 2 consecutive unchanged rounds without live IDE orchestration.

safety-checkpoint-resume.detail: Unit-tested (WEAK): Atomic checkpoint resumption verified via DummyDesktop & ResumedModel harness; recovered from step 3, appended to audit trail, unbroken SHA-256 chain (7 events).

safety-screenshot-loop-breaker.detail: Unit-tested (WEAK): Loop breaker perceptual difference hashing tested on synthetic Pillow canvas images (max_distance=2, same_threshold=3); not verified against physical screen frames.
